epistemicStatus: EXPERIMENTAL SCENARIO-CONDITIONAL PROBABILITIES. NOT EMPIRICALLY CALIBRATED ELECTION WIN PROBABILITIES.
objective: P(final Flavio share > 50% | hypothetical reported Flavio share at exactly 5% of totalized sections), approximate by 2026 first-round municipal geography and synthetic regional arrival patterns.

calculation.baseElection: 2026 first round Flavio and Lula pair-normalized municipal shares
calculation.simulatedSampleDefinition: Select entire municipalities until reaching >=5% of first-round valid votes, rather than sampling actual ballot-box section receipts. Because of this difference, regional modeled biases cannot be considered direct measurements of real 5%-of-sections paths.
calculation.seeds: LCG modulo 2^32: seed=20261022 + 31*i + 100000*styleIndex, i in [0,999], styleIndex 0 balanced,1 moderate,2 regional. Sorted key=-ln(max(1e-12,U))/regionalWeight, U=random(seed).
calculation.residualAssumption: Normal(0,1.5 pp), manually widened beyond p90 5%-simulation errors seen in 2014/2018; not an independently validated 2026 distribution.
calculation.whyTheseWeights: Illustrative sensitivity weights, chosen by analyst; NOT estimated from an empirical sequence of elections or an objective posterior.
calculation.formula: P(win | partial p) = sum_weight [mean_over_simulated_paths Phi((p-50-bias_path)/1.5)], where 2022 path uses a single measured bias of +4.39253 pp. For winning by >=300,000 votes add 0.125 pp to final threshold assuming 120 million valid votes.
calculation.fullNumericalPrecision: Published display results rounded to 2 decimal places; probabilities represent model scenarios only.
calculation.historicalValidation: /data/early-count-5pct.json. Only one actually observed 5%-section national series available (2022), so percentages are not calibrated against repeated true early election nights.

limitations: An early 5% in real sections is not identical to 5% of first-turn municipality votes used for the simulated pathways.
First-round pair-normalized municipal preference does not fix second-round transferred votes, turnout, blank and null ballots or overseas votes.
Regional sequencing has a far larger effect on early raw percentages than simple binomial vote-count sampling; votes counted are strongly dependent.
The 10/35/35/20 scenario weight split is subjective; changing it materially changes reported probabilities.
The residual Normal(0,1.5 pp) is hypothetical, informed but not statistically calibrated by 2014/2018 backtests.
A displayed 99% in this table is NOT 99% real-world certainty and must never be labeled a guarantee or formal confidence level.
Snapshot-derived 2022 effect comes from 4.82 and 5.61 percent section snapshots (linear interpolation at 5).
